text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Negotiations between the government and striking junior doctors and nurses reached a deadlock on Sunday, mainly over whether or not the medical workers, whom government has fired, should be automatically reinstated.
- The servicing of 2,020 residential stands in the Zimbabwean capital Harare is now complete and the city council will soon start interviewing eligible beneficiaries.
